findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 121 requests to 28 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 8.8 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 5.5 MB (62%) came from third-party domains, 953 kB of it from services classified as tracking (74 requests).

18 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), casalemedia.com (Index Exchange, advertising), creativecdn.com (RTB House, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), googletagservices.com (Google, advertising).
24 cookies were set by third-party domains (48 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Strict-Transport-Security header.
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47296 rules), 19 requests were blocked. The page still made 121 requests to 28 third-party domains, including 19 tracking services in our list.
